i1.title: Roberto Cavalli Sublime Tonka Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Warm spice wrapped in golden tonka.

Roberto Cavalli Sublime Tonka Eau de Parfum 100ml is part of the Roberto Cavalli Gold Collection. Cinnamon, elemi and geranium open warm and spicy, a heart of clary sage, tobacco and frankincense adds smoky depth, and it settles onto rich tonka bean and toasty wheat bran. A warm amber scent made for everyone.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Cinnamon, Elemi, Geranium
  • Heart: Clary Sage, Tobacco, Frankincense
  • Base: Tonka Bean, Wheat Bran

Key details

  • Brand: Roberto Cavalli
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Amber · Spicy
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A warm cinnamon, elemi and geranium opening
  • A smoky clary sage, tobacco and frankincense heart
  • A rich tonka bean base
  • Part of the Roberto Cavalli Gold Collection

FAQ

What does Sublime Tonka smell like?

Cinnamon, elemi and geranium first, then clary sage, tobacco and frankincense, finishing with tonka bean and wheat bran.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
